description: Summarise an OpenAPI spec or .mockz package without serving it. For a spec, returns {title, version, openapi_version, endpoint_count, paths} with operation IDs. For a package, returns its manifest. Pass `input` as a local file or a public https URL. Use this when the user wants to know what's in a spec or package before deciding whether to serve or deploy it.

input.description: Spec file path, public https URL, or .mockz package.

name: info
